findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.easyterritory.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_map_visualization, discover_intent, auto_build, request_part_selection, analyze, request_account_upload, isochrone_build, analyze_routes, load_analysis_panel, show_map_overlay · Private data: workflow_advisor, ep_search, ep_graph_traverse, submit_feedback, direct_build, ingest_accounts, request_account_upload, request_assignment_upload, geocode_address, calculate_route, tasks_get, export_geojson, import_geojson, ezt · Public sink: discover_intent, submit_feedback, direct_build, auto_build, account_build, request_part_selection, analyze, ingest_accounts, request_account_upload, request_assignment_upload, tasks_get · Destructive: realign, delete_tal, delete_territory, analyze, calculate_route, delete_route, load_analysis_panel, configure_map, show_map_overlay, export_geojson, ezt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_map_visualization, discover_intent, auto_build, request_part_selection, analyze, request_account_upload, isochrone_build, analyze_routes, load_analysis_panel, show_map_overlay · Private data: workflow_advisor, ep_search, ep_graph_traverse, submit_feedback, direct_build, ingest_accounts, request_account_upload, request_assignment_upload, geocode_address, calculate_route, tasks_get, export_geojson, import_geojson, ezt · Public sink: discover_intent, submit_feedback, direct_build, auto_build, account_build, request_part_selection, analyze, ingest_accounts, request_account_upload, request_assignment_upload, tasks_get · Destructive: realign, delete_tal, delete_territory, analyze, calculate_route, delete_route, load_analysis_panel, configure_map, show_map_overlay, export_geojson, ezt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
